_comment: SECOND hand-written evaluation set — EMPTY UNTIL FILLED. Protocol: the questions are written by a user of the app, not by whoever is working on the parsers, and are collected BEFORE any parser change they will later judge. Set 1 (heldout.jsonl) is spent: it was consulted repeatedly while debugging, so it now measures regression rather than quality (METHODOLOGY §15). This file must not be looked at while making a change it will later be used to evaluate. Same format as set 1: {"q": ..., "intent": ..., "slots": {...}}.
